Keisen creates elegant display tables from tabular data.
It brings the display-table grammar of gt (R) and great_tables (Python) to Typst as a declarative API: a header, a stub with row groups, spanners, formatters, summary rows, footnotes and themes.

Name: Keisen (罫線) is the Japanese word for the ruled lines of a table, so the name is a creative term rather than a description of what the package does.
